[IRET.13.3] **RT-safety.** A builtin registered via `ds_register_fn_rt` is
flagged `rt_safe` (O(1)/bounded, no allocation). The action adapters register
RT-safe; the general math/string builtins register via `ds_register_fn`
(`rt_safe` defaults false).

**The refusal belongs at load** ([RTCT.7.8]): an artefact whose rules can reach
a non-`rt_safe` op under `constspace: true` — and so under `realtime`, which
requires it — is rejected with `DS_ERR_RT_UNSAFE` before any fact is
processed. An op that could fault in the pooled strategy and succeed in the
ordinary one would otherwise change a result by setting ([LDET.1.12]).

In the pooled strategy the CALL evaluator additionally rejects a non-`rt_safe` op before
invoking it. That check is **defence in depth, not the contract** — reaching it
means an artefact got past the load gate, which is a defect in the gate rather
than a condition an author can produce. It is retained because the evaluator
cannot verify that the gate ran.
